lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately 6 to 8 vertical columns, forming a semi-regular 2D grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a rectilinear grid of anchor nodes across the visible flank area.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible along the mid-lateral line, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and a defined shadow gradient on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a scattered distribution of small, high-luminance blobs, with a higher concentration observed in the anterior-lower region of the fin surface.

other_distinctive_markers: An elongated, high-luminance feature consistent with a remora is attached to the lateral surface of the caudal peduncle.
